name: Claude Code
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI for the remote user with the official native installer, so no Node.js is required in the container. Uses Claude Code's own $HOME layout, so 'claude update' works inside the container instead of leaving a second, stale copy behind.

claudeVersion.description: Claude Code version to install ('stable', 'latest', or a pinned version such as 2.1.238).
